title: Dutch Jubilant Pancakes
description: Delicious and fluffy Dutch-style pancakes made with jubilant and flour ingredients.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together jubilant, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add butter to the pan and let it melt.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter into the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve hot with your favorite toppings.
